[Back to all emotions](why-we-have-emotions.qmd)

Jealousy is often about fearing that we could lose a relationship, role, place, or attention.

## It can give us the urge to

- hold on;
- protect; or
- control.

## It may be telling us

- we may fear losing a relationship;
- a role or status matters; or
- trust feels uncertain.

## What can help

1. Check the facts.
2. Ask directly.
3. Name what you need.
4. Build trust without testing people.

## Design connection

Friendly, group-oriented symbols can communicate connection and belonging.

**Examples:** Snapchat and Discord.
